name: Clarice Foster
summary: In the Pools of Vision, Clarice Foster lives among tauren seers and mystics. Far from Lordaeron, the Forsaken woman spends her days in contemplation beneath the bluffs of Mulgore.

sections.title: A Forsaken in the Pools of Vision
sections.body: Most Forsaken remain in Lordaeron, rebuilding their kingdom beneath the Undercity. Clarice Foster has traveled to the heart of tauren lands in Kalimdor. She lives in the cavernous Pools of Vision beneath the mesa of Thunder Bluff, among Forsaken apothecaries and tauren shamans who study the spiritual and elemental mysteries of the earth.

faq.answer: Clarice Foster is a Forsaken woman in the Pools of Vision beneath Thunder Bluff. She is an envoy among the tauren of Mulgore, and one of the few undead visitors dwelling with them.

faq.q: Where can I find Clarice Foster?
faq.answer: You can find Clarice Foster in the Pools of Vision, a cave complex beneath Spirit Rise in Thunder Bluff.

aliases: until death do us part quest
faq.answer: Clarice Foster offers Until Death Do Us Part. Bitter that her late husband left her to fight the undead and died, she sends travelers to lay his pendant on his tomb at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.

angles.text: As Forsaken, Clarice Foster reflects your people's ties to their tauren allies in Kalimdor, far from the blight-stained soil of Tirisfal and Silverpine.
As a tauren, you see Clarice Foster welcomed into the sacred Pools of Vision beneath Spirit Rise, a sign of your people's willingness to host unconventional newcomers to the Horde.
